    ArduinoNano - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware
    The Arduino Nano ESP32's features: its Gpio pins, primary I2c bus, USB Mouse, onboard Wifi, Clock, board identity (BoardModel), and arena and flash figures (BoardMemory).
    ArduinoNanoEsp32Board - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations
    Selects the Arduino Nano ESP32 as @Board's target: Juno programs run on its ESP32-S3, a dual-core Xtensa LX7, under Arduino's arduino:esp32 core.
    ArduinoNanoEsp32Image - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.util.image
    Generated from arduino-nano-esp32.png, rotated 90 degrees counterclockwise, then displayed rotated 180 degrees.
    ArduinoNanoEsp32Image(TftTouchShield) - Constructor for class io.github.jabrena.juno.util.image.ArduinoNanoEsp32Image
    Draws on tft, the program's one shield instance.
    ArduinoUno - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware
    The Arduino UNO board's microcontroller unit (MCU): its Gpio pins, its I2c bus, its Spi bus, its USB Mouse, its built-in LedMatrix, its onboard Wifi, its onboard Accelerometer and Gyroscope, its Clock, which board it is (BoardModel) and its arena and flash figures (BoardMemory).
    ArduinoUnoBoardImage - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.util.image
    Generated by CoverImageGenerator from 2.png, rotated 90 degrees clockwise; do not edit by hand.
    ArduinoUnoBoardImage(TftTouchShield) - Constructor for class io.github.jabrena.juno.util.image.ArduinoUnoBoardImage
    Draws on tft, the program's one shield instance.
    ArduinoUnoQBoard - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations
    Selects the Arduino UNO Q as @Board's target: Juno programs run on its STM32U585 microcontroller (Cortex-M33) under Arduino's Zephyr core.
    ArduinoUnoR3Board - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations
    Selects the classic Arduino UNO R3 as @Board's target: Juno programs run on its ATmega328P, an 8-bit AVR with 2 KB SRAM and 32 KB flash, under Arduino's arduino:avr core.
    ArduinoUnoR3WiFiRev2Board - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations
    Selects the Arduino UNO WiFi Rev2 as @Board's target: Juno programs run on its ATmega4809, an 8-bit megaAVR (6 KB SRAM, 48 KB flash), under Arduino's arduino:megaavr core, with Wi-Fi through the u-blox NINA-W102 module and the WiFiNINA library.
    ArduinoUnoR4WiFiBoard - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations
    Selects the Arduino UNO R4 WiFi as @Board's target; has the onboard 12x8 LED matrix.
    ArduinoWifiShield - Class in io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.wifi
    The retired Arduino WiFi Shield, the UNO R3's only way onto a Wi-Fi network: the R3 has no radio of its own, so ArduinoUno.getWifi() is rejected there and the program takes its Wifi from this shield instead.

    io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations - package io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations
    Compile-time-only annotations an entry-point class uses to configure Juno's compilation, read directly from the class file rather than at runtime.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware
    The board's own hardware and program-wide introspection: ArduinoUno and ArduinoNano hand out the board's pins, I2C bus, USB mouse, LED matrix, clock, BoardModel (which board the program was compiled for) and BoardMemory (Juno's arena and the program's flash usage).
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.audio - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.audio
    The board's audio output.

    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.carrier - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.carrier
    Pin maps for passive carrier boards a Nano plugs into, currently NanoConnectorCarrier: its microSD slot, Grove and Qwiic connectors are ordinary Nano header pins, so a carrier needs no compiler intrinsic of its own.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove
    Zero-allocation drivers and pin names for peripherals connected through the Grove Base Shield.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.display - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.display
    Grove monochrome display adapters.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.sensors - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove.sensors
    Allocation-free Grove sensor drivers for digital, analog, I2C and infrared modules connected through the GroveBaseShield pin map.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.imu - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.imu
    Motion sensing: NineAxisMotionShield, the orientation sensor of the Arduino 9 Axis Motion Shield, over I2c.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.ir - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.ir
    Infrared serial transport: Infrared bit-bangs framed bytes over a 38 kHz IR receiver module and an IR LED on plain pins.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.ir.hx - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.ir.hx
    HX-53 emitter and HX-M121 receiver implementations of Juno's infrared transport interfaces: HX53InfraredEmitter and HXM121InfraredReceiver.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.kasa - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.kasa
    Allocation-free local-network control of legacy TP-Link Kasa HS100 and HS110 smart plugs.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.lcd - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.lcd
    Drivers for character LCD shields, currently LcdKeypadShield: a 16x2 HD44780-compatible display in 4-bit mode plus 5 buttons read from a single resistor-ladder analog pin, wired for the shield's standard pinout.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.motor - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.motor
    DC-motor controller adapters.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.sd - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.sd
    SPI SD-card access: SdCard, taken from the shield that holds the card's socket (such as the DataLoggerShield), opens files through an InputStream accepted by Juno's bounded intrinsic implementation of Properties.load(java.io.InputStream).
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.servo - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.servo
    Motor handles: Servo drives a standard 3-wire hobby servo through the Arduino Servo library, and PwmServoShield drives up to sixteen of them from a PCA9685 servo shield over I2C.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.tft - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.tft
    Drivers for TFT display shields, currently TftTouchShield: the ELEGOO 2.8" 240x320 ILI9341 display on an 8-bit parallel bus, with a resistive touch panel and a microSD socket (its card is TftTouchShield.getSdCard()).
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.wifi - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.wifi
    Wi-Fi shields, currently ArduinoWifiShield: the retired Arduino WiFi Shield, which gives the UNO R3 the Wifi it has no radio for.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.display - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.display
    Board displays.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.gpio - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.gpio
    General-purpose digital/analog I/O: Gpio, the raw pin-number operations (pinMode/digitalWrite/digitalRead/ analogRead/analogWrite/toggle), and DigitalOutput, a zero-cost handle bound to one output pin (high/low/toggle/isHigh) for callers that prefer an object-shaped API over passing a pin number to every call.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.hid - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.hid
    USB HID mouse control: Mouse, which ArduinoUno.getMouse() hands out, backed by the Arduino Mouse library.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.i2c - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.i2c
    I2C register access: I2c reads and writes the registers of a peripheral on the board's primary I2C bus.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal
    The board's native implementations: the classes whose methods are compiler intrinsics.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.keyboard - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.keyboard
    Board keyboards.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.led - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.led
    The built-in LED matrix of the UNO R4 WiFi (12x8) and the UNO Q (13x8): LedMatrix, the raw begin/loadFrame/clear operations that ArduinoUno.getLedMatrix() hands out, and LedCanvas, a boolean[HEIGHT][MAX_WIDTH] pixel buffer with shape and text drawing helpers that render into it and send it to the board's matrix with show.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net
    Wi-Fi connectivity for the UNO R4 WiFi, UNO Q, UNO WiFi Rev2 and the UNO R3 with the Arduino WiFi Shield: Wifi connects and reads the board's address.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.email - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.email
    Basic SMTP send / POP3S read built on Wifi's connection: Smtp to send a plain-text message to one recipient, and Pop3Client to report the mailbox message count and read the newest message's From/Subject and a bounded plain-text body into caller-owned buffers.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.http - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.http
    HTTP(S) client and server support built on Wifi's connection: HttpClient to send http:// and https:// requests into a caller-owned byte[] response buffer, Json to read typed values directly out of a response buffer without building a parsed document, and HttpServer (plain HTTP only) to serve requests, with HttpMethod/HttpStatus as named constants for both directions.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.udp - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.udp
    The SNTP clock behind LocalDateTime.now(): SntpClock configures the server, and the exchange runs on a DatagramSocket of its own.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.power - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.power
    Battery and power-management APIs for supported boards.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.serial - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.serial
    USB serial output: Serial and its BaudRate constants.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.spi - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.spi
    SPI transfers: Spi clocks bytes over the board's primary bus.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.time - package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.time
    Time: Clock is the monotonic uptime clock, for measuring elapsed time without blocking.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.pf - package io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.pf
    LEGO Power Functions infrared remote control.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.poweredup - package io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.poweredup
    Remote control of LEGO Powered Up hubs over Bluetooth Low Energy, backed by the Arduino ArduinoBLE library.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx - package io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx
    LEGO Mindstorms RCX infrared remote control, brick commands, sensors, and firmware transfer.

    General-purpose utilities: Delay blocks for a number of milliseconds or microseconds, Random provides seeded, bounded pseudorandom numbers backed by Arduino's generator, and UuidCodec converts supported UUID values to and from caller-owned 16-byte network representations.
